record.question: Apart from drugs, Pharmacopoeias also contain information on:
record.explanation: Official final key: B — Food supplements. MPSC notification 9 March 2026, Group B non-gazetted technical H&FW examination held 29 January–2 February 2026; key physical page 9, printed Q4. Source limitation: The category is not bounded to a named pharmacopoeia/edition; multiple non-drug material categories may be covered and a single answer is not established. The final key establishes the historical marking choice without removing that limitation.
